Regulation: B.C. Reg. 165/2026
Made under: Teachers Act
Published in: No. 18 – B.C. Regs. 164 to 165, October 20, 2026
Deposit date: October 15, 2026

B.C. Reg. 165/2026, deposited October 15, 2026, under theTEACHERS ACT[section 81]. Ministerial Order M374/2026, dated October 15, 2026. I, Lisa Beare, Minister of Education and Child Care, order that the British Columbia Teachers’ Council Regulation, B.C. Reg. 2/2012, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — L. BEARE,Minister of Education and Child Care. 1	Section 7.1 of the British Columbia Teachers’ Council Regulation, B.C. Reg. 2/2012, is amended (a)	in subsection (1) by striking out "November 10, 2023" and substituting "November 13, 2026", and (b)	in subsections (1), (2) and (3) by striking out "2024 election" and substituting "2027 election". 2	Section 8 (1) is amended by striking out "2024 election" and substituting "2027 election" and by striking out "February 2, 2024" and substituting "February 5, 2027". 3	Section 9 is amended by striking out "February 2, 2024" wherever it appears and substituting "February 5, 2027". 4	Section 10 (1) is amended by striking out "2024 election" and substituting "2027 election" and by striking out "March 20, 2024" and substituting "March 19, 2027". minutes_briefs.title: BC Teachers' Council election dates pushed to 2027 under amended regulation
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 165/2026 amends the British Columbia Teachers' Council Regulation (the rules for how the council that oversees teacher certification is run). It moves the council's election timeline from 2024 to 2027 and shifts several fixed dates: the nomination or eligibility cut-off moves from November 10, 2023 to November 13, 2026, and key election steps move from February 2, 2024 to February 5, 2027 and from March 20, 2024 to March 19, 2027. The change was made by ministerial order under the Teachers Act and published October 20, 2026.
